shots.description: Cover shot. The trophy checklist scrolled to trophy #48, with its detail panel open on the right: the name Actions Speak Louder, its Bronze grade, the guide text, the Missable badge and warning, the Hidden and 500 choices chips, the sources line, and the Mark as earned button.

The Roadmap to the platinum view: the five stages in play order, each with its per-stage earned count and progress bar. Stage 1 Opening moves (0/4 earned) and stage 2 Chapters 2 and 3 (0/10 earned) are in frame; stages 3 to 5 continue below.

Spoiler mode switched on. Un-earned story trophies show as Hidden story trophy with their name, description and guide masked behind the spoiler notice, while the earned-state and grade chips stay visible. The platinum trophy above them is unaffected because it is not a story trophy.

The kind filter set to Collectibles with two trophies marked earned through their checkboxes. The header reads 2 / 55 earned with per-grade progress, the status line reads Showing 4 of 55 trophies, and the first collectible shows its checked box and Earned tag.
